reason: The free first visit costs me nothing, and the daily cleaning log, shoes off and a cap on how many kids are in at once are exactly what I look for. If it is as clean and calm as it says, $13 is nothing for an hour where I can sit down with a coffee.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? A gated Baby Nook helps, but I want to see how it actually works on a Tuesday morning before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing in person that the under-2 area stays separate and calm, with a posted cleaning log that looks real. If it is chaotic on my free visit, I will not come back.
